module calendar(
    input CLK, input RST,
    output reg [5:0] Hours, Mins, Secs
);

    always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
        if (RST) begin
            Secs <= 6'b000000;
        end
        else if (Secs == 6'd59) begin
            Secs <= 6'b000000;
        end
        else begin
            Secs <= Secs + 1;
        end
    end

    always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
        if (RST) begin
            Mins <= 6'b000000;
        end
        else if (Mins == 6'd59 && Secs == 6'd59) begin
            Mins <= 6'b000000;
        end
        else if (Secs == 6'd59) begin
            Mins <= Mins + 1;
        end
        else begin
            Mins <= Mins;
        end
    end

    always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST) begin
        if (RST) begin
            Hours <= 6'b000000;
        end
        else if (Hours == 6'd23 && Mins == 6'd59 && Secs == 6'd59) begin
            Hours <= 6'b000000;
        end
        else if (Mins == 6'd59 && Secs == 6'd59) begin
            Hours <= Hours + 1;
        end
        else begin
            Hours <= Hours;
        end
    end

endmodule

<module id="calendar">
    <description>Implement a perpetual calendar that tracks seconds, minutes, and hours.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="CLK">Clock input.</input>
        <input id="RST">Active high reset signal.</input>
        <output id="Hours" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current hours.</output>
        <output id="Mins" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current minutes.</output>
        <output id="Secs" width_description="[5:0]">6-bit output representing the current seconds.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="Secs">Seconds counter.</parameter>
        <parameter id="Mins">Minutes counter.</parameter>
        <parameter id="Hours">Hours counter.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="Secs" type="wire" width_description="[5:0]">Seconds counter.</reg>
        <reg id="Mins" type="wire" width_description="[5:0]">Minutes counter.</reg>
        <reg id="Hours" type="wire" width_description="[5:0]">Hours counter.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Implement a perpetual calendar that counts seconds, minutes, and hours.</implementation>
</module>
